# Timothy Markfeld

> Senior software engineer in St. Petersburg, Florida. I build reliable software and work across healthcare, logistics, and AI. Currently at FirmPilot, building the systems behind AI-powered marketing.

- Site: https://timmarkfeld.com/
- Email: mail@timmarkfeld.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/tcmarkfeld
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/timothy-markfeld
- Education: Master’s and B.S. in MIS, University of Alabama

## Experience

- FirmPilot, Senior Software Engineer (2025 to now): AI-powered marketing platforms, distributed AWS workers, secure GraphQL APIs, and automated content pipelines serving hundreds of client sites.
- HCA Healthcare, Data Integration Engineer II (2023 to 2025): 200+ HIPAA-regulated microservices processing more than one million events a day; EHR integration through FHIR, HL7, and IHE.
- Corolla Ice Delivery, Full Stack Engineer (2020 to 2023): a React Native delivery app on the App Store and Google Play, with route optimization that cut daily delivery time by up to 3 hours.

## Projects

- [Revise](https://revise.timmarkfeld.com/): a native macOS app that edits PDFs like a doc, no conversions. Rust, egui, PDFium. Source: https://github.com/tcmarkfeld/revise-pdf
- [HL7Kit](https://github.com/tcmarkfeld/HL7Kit): strongly typed HL7 parsing and FHIR conversion for .NET. NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/HL7Kit and https://www.nuget.org/packages/HL7Kit.Fhir
- [Conductor](https://github.com/tcmarkfeld/Conductor): least-privilege IAM and Terraform from messaging config (SQS queues and SNS topics). NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Conductor.Tool

## Writing

- [Editing a PDF like it’s a doc](https://timmarkfeld.com/blog/revise/): why I built Revise, and how it turns a PDF back into something you can actually edit.
- [Routing ice across the Outer Banks](https://timmarkfeld.com/blog/corolla-ice-delivery/): how I routed ice deliveries around Corolla to avoid left turns, and the up to three hours it saved a day.
